programs.title: Searching for Satoshi - The Mysterious Disappearance of the Bitcoin Creator
programs.desc: On January 3, 2009, a mysterious figure or group nicknamed Satoshi Nakamoto introduced a state-of-the-art monetary invention - the digital currency bitcoin.Just 26 months after the creation of the most famous cryptocurrency, the creator disappeared with over a million bitcoins.His fortune, now estimated at $70 billion, remains untouched.Satoshi has not been heard from since the beginning of 2011, and his legend grows every day.The program will try to answer the question of the reasons for this mysterious disappearance.It remains to be seen whether this is a strategic decision planned from the beginning.

programs.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, former host of 'Top Gear', presents a refreshed version of the iconic game show, in which correct answers to 12 questions guarantee participants a prize of one million pounds.
